newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITI minister Sato says has no Nomura account.
newsitem.headline: MITI minister Sato says has no Nomura account.

text.p: Japanese Minister of International Trade and Industry (MITI) Shinji Sato said on Tuesday that neither he nor his family members had had dealings with Nomura Securities Co Ltd.

Sato, speaking to reporters at a news conference, said that neither he nor his family had ever had any dealings with Nomura Securities in the past, but added that he had not checked on the status of his personal secretary.

Nomura is at the heart of a scandal involving suspected illegal stock deals. Earlier on Tuesday, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said three cabinet ministers had held so-called VIP accounts which were given special treatment by the brokerage.
